body:
Greg's decision, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #853, 2026-10-16 00:19:12Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2), in answer to #852 about w-d264adbde8df (the supervised-pilot onboarding dry run): "Greg: no hurry. Do not run the fixture-clone dry run now; wait until the relevant work is on main. Then perform the pilot validation on the Phoenix project instead of .tmp/pilot-dryrun-9474. Prepare the handoff/instructions, but do not require a UI step until main is ready and you send the concrete request."
Rules:
- No dry run on the C# fixture clone.
- The pilot validation targets the Phoenix project, once the relevant work is on master.
- Opus3 (the holder) prepares the handoff and instructions now.
- Greg's UI step (opening a session) is requested only when master is ready, via a concrete request through Advisor.

UPDATE, Greg via Advisor #854 (2026-10-16 00:20:13Z), verbatim: "Greg authorizes a real pilot on Phoenix: select one safe independent P3 item and run it through the normal runner/test/evaluation path to validate the workflow. First inspect whether Phoenix is already a TermAl project with an eligible root session. Report the proposed item, why it is isolated, exact session/project route, and any one UI action Greg must take. Do not start the item or create a new project/session until that report is sent; use current main when ready."
State: Opus3 is doing a read-only inspection (03723eab #2732). Candidate root sessions: Phoenix::Codex session-10848 and Phoenix::Website 6214, both idle. Phoenix::Fable 5505 and WebsiteFable 6240 are in error. Report to Greg via Advisor; NOTHING starts before his reply to the report.
